title: @lsanger The point is the user gets to be in control would we be better on social networks only committed to open standards and making read/write APIs
summary: @lsanger The point is the user gets to be in control would we be better on social networks only committed to open standards and making read/write APIs public..of course. Twitter could cut off the APIs like facebook or just go away like Google+ and it would be a moot point.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @lsanger The point is the user gets to be in control would we be better on social networks only committed to open standards and making read/write APIs public..of course. Twitter could cut off the APIs like facebook or just go away like Google+ and it would be a moot point.
